description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing Wi-Fi driver operations for a hostapd (Access Point Daemon) interface. It contains driver callback implementations for managing Wi-Fi stations, encryption keys, authentication, and related Wi-Fi functionalities, with functions to send/receive EAPOL frames, manage WPS IEs, handle station actions, and integrate with hostapd callbacks.

methods.name: u8 wifi_get_snr_value(char * ifname,unsigned char * assoc_cli_mac)
methods.description: Retrieves the SNR value for a connected client given interface name and MAC address, using ioctl drive calls and associated device info.

methods.name: const char * ether_sprintf(const u8 * addr)
methods.description: Converts a MAC address (u8 array) into a human-readable MAC string format.

methods.name: int send_eapol(void * priv,const u8 * addr,const u8 * data,size_t data_len,int encrypt,const u8 * own_addr,u32 flags)
methods.description: Constructs and sends an EAPOL frame encapsulated in Ethernet frames over wireless interface.

methods.name: void handle_read(void * ctx,const u8 * src_addr,const u8 * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Placeholder for a receive handler callback for incoming EAPOL frames (currently unused).

methods.name: void * drv_init(struct hostapd_data * hapd,struct wpa_init_params * params)
methods.description: Initializes driver context, allocates memory, sets interface details, and prepares the driver for operation.

methods.name: int set_privacy(void * priv,int enabled)
methods.description: Enables or disables wireless privacy (encryption) mode in the driver.

methods.name: int set_ssid(void * priv,const u8 * buf,int len)
methods.description: Sets the SSID of the access point interface in driver.

methods.name: int sta_deauth(void * priv,const u8 * own_addr,const u8 * addr,u16 reason_code)
methods.description: Deauthenticates a station given its MAC address and reason.

methods.name: int flush(void * priv)
methods.description: Deauthenticates all stations from the interface (leave all stations).

methods.name: int del_key(void * priv,const u8 * addr,int key_idx)
methods.description: Deletes a stored encryption key for a station.

methods.name: int set_key(const char * ifname,void * priv,enum wpa_alg alg,const u8 * addr,int key_idx,int set_tx,const u8 * seq,size_t seq_len,const u8 * key,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Sets an encryption key for a station with specified algorithms and parameters.

methods.name: int set_authmode(void * priv,int auth_algs)
methods.description: Sets the authentication mode (e.g., open, shared) for the interface.

methods.name: int configure_wpa(struct driver_data * drv,struct wpa_bss_params * params)
methods.description: Configures WPA security parameters for the interface, including cipher suites, key management, and RSN capabilities.

methods.name: int set_ieee8021x(void * priv,struct wpa_bss_params * params)
methods.description: Configures IEEE 802.1X and WPA settings on the interface.

methods.name: int send_mgmt(void * priv,const u8 * frm,size_t data_len,int noack,unsigned int freq,const u16 * csa_offs,size_t csa_offs_len)
methods.description: Sends a management (mgmt) frame, such as a WNM or neighbor report, over the wireless interface.

methods.name: int set_ap(void * priv,struct wpa_driver_ap_params * params)
methods.description: Configures various AP parameters including IE elements, security, and other operational attributes.

methods.name: int sta_auth(void * priv,struct wpa_driver_sta_auth_params * params)
methods.description: Performs station authentication/responses with provided parameters.

methods.name: int set_sta_authorized(void * priv,const u8 * addr,int authorized)
methods.description: Authorizes or deauthorizes a station MAC address in the driver.

methods.name: int sta_set_flags(void * priv,const u8 * addr,unsigned int total_flags,unsigned int flags_or,unsigned int flags_and)
methods.description: Sets various flags on stations; currently, primarily focused on authorization state.

methods.name: int sta_assoc(void * priv,const u8 * own_addr,const u8 * addr,int reassoc,u16 status_code,const u8 * ie,size_t len)
methods.description: Sends an association response to a station, including status and IE data.

methods.name: int commit(void * priv)
methods.description: Completes initialization, waits until interface is up and ready for operation.

methods.name: int reset_appfilter(struct driver_data * drv)
methods.description: Resets packet filter on the driver.

methods.name: int sta_disassoc(void * priv,const u8 * own_addr,const u8 * addr,u16 reason_code)
methods.description: Disassociates a station for a given reason.

methods.name: int add_tspec(void * priv,const u8 * addr,u8 * tspec_ie,size_t tspec_ielen)
methods.description: Adds a traffic stream (TSPEC) for a station (IEEE 802.11r/WTM).

methods.name: int add_sta_node(void * priv,const u8 * addr,u16 auth_alg)
methods.description: Adds a station node to driver with associated authentication algorithm.

methods.name: int hapd_receive_pkt(struct driver_data * drv)
methods.description: Registers or sets up flow to receive packets in hostapd.

methods.name: int set_ap_wps_ie(void * priv,const struct wpabuf * beacon,const struct wpabuf * proberesp,const struct wpabuf * assocresp)
methods.description: Sets WPS IE elements for beacon, probe response, and association response frames.

methods.name: int set_opt_ie(void * priv,const u8 * ie,size_t ie_len)
methods.description: Sets generic IE (Information Element) data in the driver for beacon and probe responses.

methods.name: int sta_get_seqnum(const char * ifname,void * priv,const u8 * addr,int idx,u8 * seq)
methods.description: Retrieves sequence number for a station, used in WPA security protocols.
